parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Good afternoon. Can I help you?

Yes, I'm looking for some places to visit when my sister and her children come to stay. They arrive this weekend from overseas. I'm new to the area and don't really know what to recommend. Do you have any ideas?

What about going to Alma Park to visit the zoo?

Ooh, I like the idea of that. Is it reasonably priced?

Yes, it's not a bad price. A standard adult ticket is normally $30, but there's a special deal for families of $65, which is a saving of $35.

That's a great deal. How do we get there from the city?

You can go by bus.

Is it very far?

The 385 will get you there in approximately 40 minutes depending on traffic. There is another bus, the 388, but it takes 20 minutes longer, so it's worth waiting a few more minutes for the more direct bus.

Okay. Are there any special things to do there? Can you feed the animals or anything like that?

They've stopped that, but most tourists love the fact that you're allowed to hold some of the animals and get your photo taken. They just ask you to make a small payment to help with costs.

Ah, the kids would love that. My sister also likes going to the theatre. Is there anything good on at the moment? She especially likes comedies.

There's a place called the Entertainment Room in Ascot. I'll just check their website. Hmm, yes, there's a festival running at the moment with John Rosie as the main entertainer. He's really funny.

How do you spell that? Is it ROZY?

No, it's ROSIE.

Got it. And when is it on?

Next week, it says it starts on Tuesday with a special matinee show on the Wednesday, but because of the demand it's been extended to Saturday.

It must be good then. Is it expensive?

I don't think so. Let's see. Ah, it says there's a special preview show on the Monday and they're offering a discount on tickets that night.

We'll try and go then in that case. I also wanted to spend a day in the city centre. The children will get bored just looking at the shops. Is there anything else for them to do? What's the museum like?

It's very popular with children and there's a very hands-on exhibition on at the moment.

They love that. Sounds good. And there's a workshop on where they learn how to do origami.

Will they need to bring anything special for that?

On this leaflet, it says that things like scissors and all of the paper are provided. They just advise children to bring a box to carry the completed origami home in. Just a little one will do.

I'm also looking for a weekend activity. I've heard Bunyabbie Island is great. Would we need a car to get around the island?

A four-wheel drive is a great way to explore. You should also try snorkeling at Salty Lake.

Is that in the centre of the island near the mountain? 

No, it's on the ocean side. 

Okay, I'll get a map and check it out. I'd like to stay there at least one night and I quite like the idea of taking a tent and sleeping out in the open air. Are you allowed to camp there? 

That would be lovely, but I'm afraid the land is all...

analyses.content: 录音明确说家庭套票（deal for families）的价格是 65 美元。
A standard adult ticket is normally $30, but there's a special deal for families of $65, which is a saving of $35.
你可能听到 35 就想填，但录音说那是“节省了（saving of）”35 美元，不是票价。
The 385 will get you there in approximately 40 minutes depending on traffic.
另一辆 388 路车要“多花 20 分钟（20 minutes longer）”，也就是 60 分钟，不要听到 20 就填。
录音说 385 路车大约需要 40 分钟（approximately 40 minutes）到达那里。
They've stopped that, but most tourists love the fact that you're allowed to hold some of the animals and get your photo taken.
题目是 "have a ..."，对应录音中的 "get your photo taken"，需提取名词 photo。
录音提到游客喜欢抱动物并“拍照（get your photo taken）”，但这需要支付小额费用。
Is it ROZY? No, it's ROSIE.
注意听男士说的 "No"，他否定了女生拼的 ROZY，一定要写纠正后的版本。
这是一道拼写题，录音特意纠正了拼写，是 ROSIE。
Next week, it says it starts on Tuesday... but because of the demand it's been extended to Saturday.
不要填 Tuesday（开始时间）或 Wednesday（特场时间），题目问的是 "run to..."（持续到...）。
录音说因为需求火爆，演出已经“延长到了周六（extended to Saturday）”。
录音说周一晚上的预演秀提供门票“折扣（discount）”。
Ah, it says there's a special preview show on the Monday and they're offering a discount on tickets that night.
听到 "Monday" 和 "tickets" 时要竖起耳朵，答案就在紧随其后的 "offering a..." 后面。
What's the museum like? It's very popular with children and there's a very hands-on exhibition on at the moment.
题目问去哪里看展览，录音虽然先问了 "What's the museum like?"，但答案就是这个地点。
录音中提到市中心的“博物馆（museum）”现在有一个通过实践操作的展览（exhibition）。
They just advise children to bring a box to carry the completed origami home in. Just a little one will do.
Scissors（剪刀）和 paper（纸）是提供的（provided），不需要带，别填错了。
录音建议孩子们带一个“盒子（box）”把做好的折纸带回家，而且只要一个小的（little one）。
Is that in the centre of the island near the mountain? No, it's on the ocean side.
不要听到 centre 或 mountain 就填，录音对此进行了明确的否定 "No"。
录音明确说咸水湖是在“海洋一侧（ocean side）”。
Are you allowed to camp there? That would be lovely, but I'm afraid the land is all...
题目是 "not allowed to"，对应录音中被委婉否定的动作 camp。
生问能不能“露营（camp）”，男士回答 "I'm afraid..." 表示否定，即不允许露营。
